function.name: SceneResource_InstantiateQueuedActor
function.body: Tests SCENE_RESOURCE_ACTOR_SPAWN_GATE. When enabled, reads the next X word from SCENE_RESOURCE_ACTOR_RECORD_CURSOR and returns on zero; reads the Y word, calls Actor_FindFreeSlot, and returns if no slot is available. It initializes the selected slot from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_SCENE_RESOURCE_QUEUED, stores the X/Y pair at actor offsets +0x02/+0x04, and publishes the cursor advanced past the pair.

0x00FF7282.name: SCENE_RESOURCE_ACTOR_RECORD_CURSOR
0x00FF7282.access: longword cursor read, then advanced by four bytes after successful allocation

limitations: No direct static caller was recovered in the current whole-ROM export.
The full coordinate-record extent and spawn-gate producer are not claimed.
The shared animation stream is classified separately as ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE84_SHARED_0F22_RESPONSE; its broader scene-resource role remains intentionally limited to the fixed template reference.
conclusion: The compact code-like gap is a scene-resource queued-actor allocator wrapper, not data. Its fixed Type-0x84 template and success-only coordinate-cursor publication are now represented as structured metadata; the surrounding producer path remains open.
